unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: These people are standing in a queue to get into the cinema.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 排队的人像字母q-u-e-u-e一样排成一长串。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The auditorium is packed with seated people watching a movie screen.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: audio（声音）+ torium（场所）= 听音乐或看电影的礼堂。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The government will be making a statement about the crisis later today.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 快（cri）死（sis）了，说明遇到了大危机。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Later in the programme, I'll be talking to the Minister of Education.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: mini（小）+ ster（人），虽然叫小人，但其实是国家的大臣。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The team's star player is injured and won't be playing in the game on Saturday.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: in（在里面）+ jury（伤害），身体内部受伤了。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Every day he follows the same routine and tomorrow will be no exception.

unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: ex（出）+ cept（拿）+ ion，拿出去不一样的就是例外。
e + lec（选择）+ tion，大家一起投票选择。
fast（快/固定）+ en（使…），使固定系牢。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: I will be doing something is the future continuous tense.
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: future（将来）+ continuous（进行）= 将来进行时。
